jobs.description:
Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada si è costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione di innovazione. Il Gruppo, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, opera in oltre 45 paesi con i marchi PRADA, Miu Miu, Church's e Car Shoe, e conta dipendenti di oltre 100 nazionalità.

SCOPO

La figura ricercata ha una forte sensibilità al prodotto e un background tecnico in area Abbigliamento di lusso con comprovata esperienza su capospalla tecnico. All’interno della Divisione Prada Uomo Lifestyle, sarà responsabile della gestione della catena produttiva relativa al capospalla sportswear, supervisionando attività e flussi operativi di circa 60 persone. Il ruolo prevede il coordinamento della catena nelle fasi di prototipia, campionario e produzione, garantendo efficienza, qualità e allineamento con le esigenze stilistiche e industriali del Gruppo.

RESPONSABILITÀ

• Gestione e coordinamento del personale (circa 60 persone) e organizzazione della catena e del flusso di lavoro per far fronte alle diverse esigenze (sfilate, prototipia, campionario, produzione, pubblicità).

• Gestione dei rapporti e delle informazioni con gli uffici e i reparti strettamente collegati (Ufficio Prodotto, Modelleria, Cad, Produzione, Controllo qualità )

• Risoluzione di criticità tecniche che possono intervenire nello sviluppo di un capo

• Sviluppare reportistiche relative allo stato di avanzamento di una collezione.

REQUISITI E CONOSCENZE

Ottima conoscenza tecnica del capospalla uomo sportswear di lusso, realizzato in nylon e tessuti tecnici

10-15 anni di esperienza nel ruolo di Responsabile Laboratorio e/o Ispettore Tecnico Laboratori esterni

Buona conoscenza delle macchine da cucire e capacità di utilizzo delle stesse

Autonomia nell’utilizzo di Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

Capacità di Gestione del personale e distribuzione e monitoraggio del lavoro all’interno del team

Capacità di sviluppare reportistica relativa a stato avanzamento di collezione.

Aver ottenuto un attestato di frequenza ad un corso specifico in ambito abbigliamento verrà considerato un plus.

Cura del dettaglio, flessibilità e sensibilità al prodotto

Entrare a far parte della nostra Azienda significa lavorare in un ambiente creativo e internazionale, con team di persone motivate dalla curiosità e dalla ricerca dell'eccellenza. Il motore del nostro successo è l'importanza e il valore che diamo al talento e alla passione delle nostre persone, favorendone la crescita professionale.
 Il Gruppo Prada promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, garantendo pari opportunità a tutti i candidati, indipendentemente da genere, etnia, orientamento sessuale, disabilità, o altre caratteristiche personali. Crediamo che la diversità sia un valore e ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente di lavoro equo e rispettoso per tutti.

descriptionByLocale.en: Description Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in luxury, operates in over 45 countries with the brands PRADA, Miu Miu, Church's and Car Shoe, and employs over 100 nationalities. The researched figure has a strong sensitivity to the product and a technical background in the area Luxury clothing with proven experience on technical outerwear. Within the Prada Men Lifestyle Division, he will be responsible for managing the production chain related to sportswear, overseeing activities and operating flows of about 60 people. The role involves the coordination of the chain in the stages of prototyping, sampling and production, ensuring efficiency, quality and alignment with the Group's stylistic and industrial needs. Responsibility - Management and coordination of staff (approximately 60 people) and organization of the chain and workflow to meet the different needs (swimming, prototyping, sampling, production, advertising). - Management of relations and information with the offices and departments closely linked (Product Office, Modelling, Cad, Production, Quality Control) - Resolution of technical criticalities that can intervene in the development of a garment - Develop reports regarding the progress of a collection. Requirements and knowledge - Excellent technical knowledge of the luxury sportswear men's outerwear, made of nylon and technical fabrics - 10-15 years of experience in the role of Laboratory Responsible and/or Technical Inspector External Laboratories - Good knowledge of sewing machines and ability to use them - Autonomy in the use of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) - Ability to Managing staff and distribution and monitoring of work within the team report - Ability to develop progress collection - Aver obtained a certificate of attendance at a specific course in clothing will be considered a plus. - Care of detail, flexibility and sensitivity to the product What we offer to be part of our company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the search for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value we give to the talent and passion of our people, encouraging their professional growth. The Prada Group promotes an inclusive working environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to building a fair and respectful working environment for all.
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Gegründet 1913 in Italien, wurde die Prada Group auf einer Tradition der Exzellenz und mit einer Vision von Innovation aufgebaut. Die Gruppe, ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Luxus, ist in über 45 Ländern mit den Marken PRADA, Miu Miu, Church's und Car Shoe tätig und beschäftigt über 100 Nationalitäten. Die recherchierte Figur hat eine starke Empfindlichkeit gegenüber dem Produkt und einen technischen Hintergrund im Bereich Luxusbekleidung mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung in technischer Oberbekleidung. Innerhalb der Prada Men Lifestyle Division wird er für die Leitung der Produktionskette im Zusammenhang mit Sportbekleidung, die Überwachung der Aktivitäten und den Betrieb von rund 60 Personen verantwortlich sein. Die Rolle umfasst die Koordination der Kette in den Phasen des Prototypings, der Probenahme und der Produktion, um Effizienz, Qualität und Übereinstimmung mit den stilistischen und industriellen Anforderungen der Gruppe zu gewährleisten. Verantwortung - Management und Koordination der Mitarbeiter (ca. 60 Personen) und Organisation der Kette und des Workflows, um die verschiedenen Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen (Schwimmen, Prototyping, Probenahme, Produktion, Werbung). - Verwaltung der Beziehungen und Informationen mit den eng miteinander verbundenen Büros und Abteilungen (Produktbüro, Modellierung, Cad, Produktion, Qualitätskontrolle) - Lösung der technischen Kritikalitäten, die in die Entwicklung eines Kleidungsstücks eingreifen können - Entwicklung von Berichten über den Fortschritt einer Kollektion. Anforderungen und Kenntnisse - Ausgezeichnete technische Kenntnisse der Luxus-Sportbekleidung Herrenoberbekleidung, aus Nylon und technischen Stoffen - 10-15 Jahre Erfahrung in der Rolle des Labors Verantwortliche und / oder Technische Inspektor Externe Laboratorien - Gute Kenntnisse der Nähmaschinen und die Fähigkeit, sie zu verwenden - Autonomie bei der Verwendung von Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) - Fähigkeit, Personal zu verwalten und Verteilung und Überwachung der Arbeit innerhalb des Teamberichts - Fähigkeit, Fortschrittssammlung zu entwickeln - Aver erhielt eine Bescheinigung über die Teilnahme an einem bestimmten Kurs in Kleidung wird als Plus angesehen. - Sorgfalt für Details, Flexibilität und Sensibilität für das Produkt Was wir anbieten, um Teil unseres Unternehmens zu sein, bedeutet, in einem kreativen und internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten, mit Teams von Menschen, die von Neugier und der Suche nach Exzellenz motiviert sind. Der Motor unseres Erfolgs ist die Bedeutung und der Wert, den wir dem Talent und der Leidenschaft unserer Mitarbeiter beimessen und deren berufliches Wachstum fördern. Die Prada Group fördert ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld, das allen Kandidaten gleiche Chancen bietet, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen. Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt ein Wert ist und wir sind bestrebt, ein faires und respektvolles Arbeitsumfeld für alle zu schaffen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Description Fondé en 1913 en Italie, le groupe Prada s'est bâti sur une tradition d'excellence et une vision d'innovation. Le Groupe, leader mondial du luxe, opère dans plus de 45 pays avec les marques PRADA, Miu Miu, Church's et Car Shoe, et emploie plus de 100 nationalités. La figure étudiée a une forte sensibilité au produit et un arrière-plan technique dans le domaine Vêtements de luxe avec une expérience prouvée sur les vêtements extérieurs techniques. Au sein de la Division du style de vie de Prada Men, il sera chargé de gérer la chaîne de production liée aux vêtements de sport, de superviser les activités et les flux opérationnels d'une soixantaine de personnes. Ce rôle implique la coordination de la chaîne aux stades du prototypage, de l'échantillonnage et de la production, en assurant l'efficacité, la qualité et l'alignement avec les besoins stylistiques et industriels du Groupe. Responsabilité - Gestion et coordination du personnel (environ 60 personnes) et organisation de la chaîne et du flux de travail pour répondre aux différents besoins (wimming, prototypage, échantillonnage, production, publicité). - Gestion des relations et de l'information avec les bureaux et départements étroitement liés (Bureau des produits, Modélisation, Cad, Production, Contrôle de la qualité) - Résolution des criticités techniques pouvant intervenir dans le développement d'un vêtement - Élaborer des rapports sur l'état d'avancement d'une collection. Exigences et connaissances - Excellente connaissance technique des vêtements de sport de luxe pour hommes, en nylon et tissus techniques - 10-15 ans d'expérience dans le rôle de Laboratoire Responsable et/ou Inspecteur technique Laboratoires externes - Bonne connaissance des machines à coudre et capacité à les utiliser - Autonomie dans l'utilisation de Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) - Capacité à gérer le personnel et la distribution et le suivi du travail au sein du rapport d'équipe - Capacité à développer la collecte de progrès - Aver obtenu un certificat de participation à un cours spécifique en vêtements sera considéré comme un plus. - Soin de détail, flexibilité et sensibilité au produit Ce que nous proposons pour faire partie de notre entreprise, c'est travailler dans un environnement créatif et international, avec des équipes de personnes motivées par la curiosité et la recherche de l'excellence. Le moteur de notre succès est l'importance et la valeur que nous accordons au talent et à la passion de notre peuple, en favorisant leur croissance professionnelle. Le Groupe Prada favorise un environnement de travail inclusif, assurant l'égalité des chances pour tous les candidats, indépendamment du sexe, de l'origine ethnique, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou d'autres caractéristiques personnelles. Nous croyons que la diversité est une valeur et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail juste et respectueux pour tous.

jobs.description:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB PURPOSE

As the Brand Store Manager, you are a passionate Brand Ambassador and a business leader, who conveys the Brand philosophy and values to the local market, the Store team and to the final Client.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Leading the Business

• Drive Store Team to exceed Financial targets and maximize sales performances, determining the success of the entire store

• Propose and develop action plans, through careful analysis of performance

• Drive the Store team to exceed their KPI targets, including cross selling and up selling among product categories

Client Development

• Place the Client above all, leading by example to create a welcoming environment and to ensure the Team strives to meet their every need and request

• Foster a Client centric mindset developing and maintaining solid Client relationships and enforcing meaningful after sales experiences

• Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service through the execution of the “Brand Selling Ceremony”

Team Management

• Act as a strong Staff motivator, promoting team spırıt through effective communication, and cultivating a positive and energetic environment, even to the eyes of the Client

• Encourage the exchange of information within the team and proactively develop morning briefing on specific topics

• Master fully all company tools and applications including IT and digital, and ensure team is constantly informed of relevant updates

• Understand the needs and priorities, train and inspire the Store team on product knowledge, sales techniques, Client Services, and Company policies and procedures

Boutique Care

• Lead by example to ensure the Team operate with the highest level of care and respect for the Product, evident in every ceremony or procedure

• Ensure display attracts Clients and maximizes sales, in accordance with Company guidelines – proactively seek VM and MD support based on store needs

• Provıde feedback and suggestions when necessary to the Visual Merchandising and the Retail Merchandising departments

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

At least 8 years of experience

Strong problem-solving and organizational skills

Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate across functions

Excellent communication skills and team spirit

Fluency in both Italian and English

Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.
